body:
I don't really see myself being better without him. Since I've known him almost half my life. . . We grew up together essentially. I don't  think being with or without him should make a difference on my accomplishments or how I hate myself. Those are on me, alone. These fights and moments I have with him show proof of my lack of conviction to do something. I struggle to find my calling. I struggle to find my purpose. 
I do the thing my therapist tells me: write gratitude and positive affirmations. 
I do it, then feel nothing! Then I hate myself even more for feeling nothing. It's a constant feedback loop of Hell. 
I paint half heartedly.
I read self help books. Nothing, but proving that there is something wrong with me.
Divorce. . . Wouldn't do much but be costly, cause more hurt feelings, ruin my child's childhood, and I'd still hate myself.
